gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all possible statuses for issues in my Jira project so that I can understand the workflow and ensure that all team members are aligned on the current state of tasks.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all statuses available in the Jira instance, including their IDs and names, allowing me to map out the workflow effectively.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to fetch the details of a specific status by its ID or name to understand its properties and how it fits into the issue lifecycle.
gold.ideal: The API should return detailed information about the specified status, including its ID, name, description, and any associated category, enabling me to implement the correct logic in my application.
